name: AircraftTurnaroundCoordinator
tagline: Every aircraft turn, its critical path and predicted off-block – in one Power Platform control.
description: Ground-handling turnaround app for Canvas, Model-driven and Power Pages: task timeline vs schedule, predicted off-block (TOBT) from the critical path, IATA-style delay codes, milestones, resource workload and conflicts, with a start / complete / delay / skip workflow, plan-a-turn template and Power Fx events.
features: Predicted off-block from the critical path
Late / at-risk / inbound / departed turn states
Planned vs actual vs projected Gantt with now, STD and TOBT lines
Delay code required when a task finishes late
Business rules: no start before On-block, no Off-block with open critical tasks, critical tasks cannot be skipped
Resource lanes with busy % and double-booking conflicts
Plan a turn from a scalable 12-task template
Bulk start / complete / delay code / export / delete with undo
Replay time for post-ops reviews and training
Demo mode with eight live-looking fictional turns
Phone layout with bottom tab bar
